sections.text: Python 3, Robot Operating System 2, image processing, source control, Gazebo

Junior Software Engineer, Helix Robotics (Mar 2025 - Aug 2026). Developed Robot Operating System 2 packages for an autonomous inspection rover, including a navigation behaviour tree and a diagnostics publisher. Wrote the Python tooling for log replay. Collaborated through a branching workflow on a shared repository.
Built an image processing pipeline for detecting corrosion in inspection footage, integrated into the rover's Robot Operating System 2 stack.
My background is in autonomous inspection robots. I describe my work in the terminology my previous team used.
